facts.fact: The International Bar Association chapter states that the Strategic Plan for Information Society 2019-2028 and its operational plan (Resolution 52/2019) include improving the civil registry components, and that e-SIRCEV was established in 2018 to centralise the registry of all events subject to civil registration; dated to the document's published year, the plan running 2019-2028.

systems.country_label: System of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (e-SIRCEV)
systems.tiers: Not stated; established 2018 to centralise the registry of all civil registration events and to interoperate with other public systems
